                        if cand_total + 1e-12 < best_total:
                            routes[ri] = new_r1
                            routes[rj] = new_r2
                            loads[ri] = route_load(new_r1)
                            loads[rj] = route_load(new_r2)
                            routes = [r for r in routes if r]
                            loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
                            best_total = total_cost(routes)
                            improved = True
                            swap_iters += 1
                            break
                        swap_iters += 1
                        if swap_iters >= max_swap_iters:
                            break

    return routes
